AD.measuredFor: Andorra, all parishes, flats for rent on Pisos.ad, EUR per m2 x 75 m2
AD.note: Pisos.ad Q2 2026 quarterly report: 117 flats for rent, average area 105.15 m2, average rent EUR 26.94 per m2 (Andorra la Vella 24.45, Escaldes-Engordany 30.73); times 75 m2. Asking rents on one portal; the Govern d'Andorra's contract-based rent study (Nov 2025) reports far lower contract rents (about EUR 9.9 per m2) because it covers old leases, so a new let is nearer the portal figure. Very thin.

AE.measuredFor: Dubai emirate, all areas (used for the UAE; Abu Dhabi is dearer, the northern emirates cheaper)
AE.note: Published as AED 77,000 a year; divided by 12. Median of registered new Ejari tenancy contracts for flats of 70 to 110 m2 (DLD does not publish bedroom counts for flats, so floor area stands in for a two-bed), 12 months to 16 Nov 2026, 84,161 contracts, all areas of the emirate. Processed by dubairealestatedata.com (CC BY 4.0) from the DLD open data on Dubai Pulse, which we could not reach directly from here.

AG.measuredFor: Antigua and Barbuda, main city, estimated
AG.note: Inferred, not measured: no published two-bed rent found. Estimated from GDP per head (USD 22,504) and the everyday price level (94), fitted on the main-city figures of 71 countries (typical error about 69%)

AR.measuredFor: Buenos Aires city (CABA) only, written under the country code because no free rent series exists for other Argentine cities
AR.note: Proxy: CABA stands for the country. Rents in Cordoba, Rosario and the provinces are lower. IDECBA, the city's statistics office, on Argenprop ads published in pesos for used flats; provisional data; asking prices, not signed leases; excludes building fees. Local room convention: 'ambientes' counts the living room, so a 3-ambientes flat is a living room plus two bedrooms, the match for a two-bed. The unit price is the average price per m2 times a fixed 70 m2; actual 3-ambientes flats average 63 m2.

AU.measuredFor: Australia: median of the six states' figures
AU.note: Median of AU-NSW 3250, AU-VIC 2643, AU-QLD 2882, AU-WA 3120, AU-SA 2199, AU-TAS 2080 AUD a month; no national two-bed figure is published

AU-NSW.measuredFor: New South Wales state-wide, two-bedroom flats and units, new private bonds Apr-Jun 2026
AU-NSW.note: NSW DCJ Rent and Sales Report, June 2026 quarter: median weekly rent for new bonds AUD 750 from 18229 bonds; x 52/12.

AU-QLD.measuredFor: Queensland state-wide, two-bedroom flats and units, new bonds Jul-Sep 2026
AU-QLD.note: RTA Queensland median rents, Flat 2: median weekly rent for new tenancies AUD 665 from 10684 bonds; x 52/12.

AU-SA.measuredFor: South Australia, whole state, two-bedroom flats/units, bonds lodged in the quarter (new tenancies)
AU-SA.note: Median weekly rent $507.50 x 52 / 12. Based on about 2200 two-bedroom flat/unit bonds lodged 1 April - 30 June 2026 (new tenancies, counts rounded to 5). SA Private Rental Report 2026-06.

AU-TAS.measuredFor: Tasmania, whole state, private two-bedroom flats/units/apartments, bonds lodged in the quarter (new tenancies)
AU-TAS.note: Median weekly rent $480.00 x 52 / 12, computed from 665 private two-bedroom unit/apartment/flat bonds lodged April-June 2026 (new tenancies), Tasmanian rental bond data.

AU-VIC.measuredFor: Melbourne (used for the state): Melbourne metropolitan region (31 municipalities), two-bedroom units, median weekly rent of the current quarter
AU-VIC.note: Median weekly rent AUD 610 x 52 / 12. REIV (Real Estate Institute of Victoria, an industry body, not a regulator) Victorian Insights page, Units tab, Metro, 2 bedrooms. REIV says its data come from real estate professionals; sample size and quarter not stated. Stand-in only: the official Victorian Rental Report (new bonds, 2-bed flats by LGA) is hosted on dffh.vic.gov.au, which refuses connections from this network. Regional Victoria 2-bed units: AUD 410 a week. Two-bedroom houses in metro Melbourne: AUD 615. Low confidence.. Written for AU-VIC from Melbourne's row: no state-wide figure

AU-WA.measuredFor: Perth (used for the state): Perth, Perth Metro region (Greater Perth, not the city centre), two-bedroom units, median weekly rent of the latest rolling three months
AU-WA.note: Median weekly rent $720 x 52 / 12. REIWA (Real Estate Institute of Western Australia, an industry body, not a regulator) Perth Metro page, Unit panel, 2BR rent, three months to October 2026, page data updated 8 Nov 2026. Rent method and sample size not stated by REIWA; its FAQ counts leasing days from advertising on reiwa.com to the lease contract date, so the rent is probably of new leases. Not bond data: the WA Bond Administrator publishes none. Unit overall $700, 1BR $600, 3BR $790; two-bedroom houses $650. Cross-check: SQM Research asking rent, 2-bed units, Perth capital city, $697.75 a week, week ending 12 Nov 2026.. Written for AU-WA from Perth's row: no state-wide figure

BD.measuredFor: Dhaka (the country's main city), Gulshan and Banani, two-bed flats
BD.note: DERIVED and thin: agency ranges for a two-bed (1,100 to 1,600 sq ft): Gulshan 1 BDT 55,000 to 110,000 (midpoint 82,500), Banani BDT 35,000 to 75,000 (midpoint 55,000); mean of the two midpoints, rounded to BDT 70,000. OM.measuredFor: Muscat (Qurum and Al Khuwair), used for Oman; the rest of Oman is cheaper
OM.note: Mean of Savills' Q2 2026 average two-bed rents for Qurum (OMR 406) and Al Khuwair (OMR 398). Savills tracks expat-oriented buildings, so this is a sought-after-district average, not a Muscat-wide median. Cross-checks: Hamptons H1 2026 asking rents OMR 450 (Qurum, Madinat Qaboos, Muscat Hills) and OMR 250 (Al Khuwair, Al Ghubra); Livingcost 80 m2 centre flat USD 1,094 = OMR 421; OpenSooq classifieds median for 2-beds of 60-100 m2 in the Muscat area OMR 240 (country OMR 190), which reflects the Omani local market. Savills' copyright notice forbids quotation without consent; the two figures are cited as facts.

PA.measuredFor: Panama City (districts such as Costa del Este, El Cangrejo, San Francisco, Bella Vista); median advertised rent of 2-bedroom flats on archived Encuentra24 result pages (the capital's sample stands for the whole area)
PA.note: VERY THIN: 9 distinct flats on 1 archived result page(s) (snapshot months 202604), quartiles 725 to 1,500; 7 of them state an area (median 65 m2); the first ads on a page are paid highlights, so the sample leans expensive. Ads are in several currencies, converted to US dollars at the 17 Nov 2026 rate (CRC 447.07, HNL 26.90, NIO 36.80, DOP 60.81, GTQ 7.64 per US$); by currency: 9 flats priced in USD (median 1,100)

PE.measuredFor: Lima's 12 central and middle-income districts only, written under the country code because no other Peruvian city has a published rent series
PE.note: Proxy: the capital's figure stands for the country. Rents outside Lima are lower; no free series exists for Arequipa, Trujillo or Cusco. BCRP table 'Alquiler anual en US$ por m2', 2nd quarter 2026, divided by 12 and multiplied by 75 m2. The BCRP derives it (district median sale price divided by a price-to-annual-rent ratio built from rents asked in nearby zones); the underlying prices are Urbania listings, 'precios listados (ofertados)', not signed leases. Kept in US dollars as published.

PG.measuredFor: Papua New Guinea, main city, estimated
PG.note: Inferred, not measured: no published two-bed rent found. Estimated from GDP per head (USD 3,418) and the everyday price level (40), fitted on the main-city figures of 71 countries (typical error about 69%)

PH.measuredFor: Makati (central business district of Metro Manila, the country's main urban area), two-bedroom condo listings
PH.note: Median asking rent for a two-bedroom condo in Makati from a sample of 57 Makati rental price points across unit sizes (the two-bed subset is smaller); BalayHub, Sep 2026. Housal's 140 Makati two-bed listings give the same median (PHP 50,000, June 2026). Leechiu's Makati average of PHP 889 per m2 (Q3 2026) would put a 77.5 m2 flat at PHP 69,000.

PK.note: Inferred, not measured: no published two-bed rent found. Estimated from GDP per head (USD 1,836) and the everyday price level (28), fitted on the main-city figures of 71 countries (typical error about 69%)

PS.measuredFor: Israel, national average (the West Bank and Gaza are not covered)
PS.note: Average over rented 3-room (CBS group 2.5-3 rooms) dwellings in the CBS price survey, not a sample of new lets.

PW.note: Inferred, not measured: no published two-bed rent found. Estimated from GDP per head (USD 21,308) and the everyday price level (66), fitted on the main-city figures of 71 countries (typical error about 69%)

PY.measuredFor: Asuncion, flats on the portal (the capital; no other Paraguayan city sampled); median advertised rent of 2-bedroom flats, without building fees
PY.note: THIN: sample of 48 flats (2 bedrooms, 50-110 m2, median 82 m2), quartiles 5,375,000 to 7,000,000; first 12 result pages at most, in the portal's default order, fetched 2026-11-17; URL https://www.infocasas.com.py/alquiler/departamentos/asuncion; also 33 listings in USD (median 1,300)

QA.note: Midpoint of Qatar Living's stated typical range of QAR 5,500-10,000 a month for two-bedrooms in Doha (mid-2026 market observations from its listings; no sample size). A range's midpoint is not a measured median. Cross-checks: the same site's October 2026 neighbourhood guide gives Al Sadd 5,500-9,000, West Bay and Lusail 9,000-15,000, The Pearl 12,000-18,000; OpenSooq classifieds give a lower median (see notes).

RW.measuredFor: Kigali, high-end neighbourhoods (Nyarutarama, Kacyiru, Kimihurura), high-end two-bedroom apartment, annual rent divided by 12 (main city only: Kigali; used as the country's figure)
RW.note: THIN and high-end segment: $15,633 a year divided by 12. The source says the figure applies to the high-end two-bedroom segment and does not represent average rents across Kigali. Listings seen on houseinrwanda.com: Kimihurura unfurnished two-bed $1,600 (2,400,000 RWF); Rebero two-bed 800 USD; Kimironko two-bed 800,000 RWF.

SA.note: Published as median annual rent SAR 50,000 for 2-bedroom apartments (7,243 listings), divided by 12. Cross-checks: Sands of Wealth blog 'about SAR 4,800' a month (Sep 2026, cites Bayut/JLL/CBRE, no sample stated); Riyadh's published rent freeze covers existing contracts, so new lets are unaffected. No Ejar or REGA average rent could be found.

SG.measuredFor: Singapore, all major private condominium projects (100+ units)
SG.note: Median of the project medians, weighted by contracts, = S$5.53 per sq ft per month over 743 projects and 21840 registered rental contracts in 2026-Q3; times 807 sq ft (75 m2). Registered rental contracts of the quarter (renewals are not separated) of all sizes in condominiums (not landed houses), so the psf figure is not filtered to two bedrooms; small units rent for more per sq ft, so a 75 m2 flat may cost slightly less than this. Projects with fewer than 10 contracts in the quarter are not in the file.

TZ.measuredFor: Dar es Salaam, typical 2-bedroom apartment, modelled estimate from portal asking rents (main city only: Dar es Salaam; used as the country's figure)
TZ.note: THIN, modelled: page last updated 2026. Quote: 'What's the average monthly rent for a 2-bedroom in Dar es Salaam as of 2026? as of 2026, the average monthly rent for a 2-bedroom apartment in Dar es Salaam is about TZS 1.55 million, which is roughly USD 595 or EUR 550. Most 2-bedroom apartments in Dar es Salaam rent for about TZS 600,000 to TZS 6 million per month, or roughly USD 230 to USD 2,300 and EUR 215 to EUR 2,140. The cheapest 2-bedroom rents in Dar es Sala'

UG.measuredFor: Kampala, typical 2-bedroom apartment, modelled estimate from portal asking rents (main city only: Kampala; used as the country's figure)
UG.note: THIN, modelled: page last updated 2026. Quote: 'What's the average monthly rent for a 2-bedroom in Kampala as of 2026? As of 2026, the average monthly rent for a 2-bedroom apartment in Kampala is about UGX 1.6 million, which is roughly USD 445 or EUR 410. Most 2-bedroom apartments in Kampala rent from about UGX 900,000 to UGX 2.5 million per month, or roughly USD 250 to USD 695 and EUR 230 to EUR 640. The cheaper 2-bedroom apartments in Kampala are often in Kyanja'

UY.measuredFor: Montevideo department, written under the country code: INE counts 70% of Uruguay's rental contracts in Montevideo (September 2026)
UY.note: Proxy: Montevideo stands for the country. Cambio Uruguay aggregates and de-duplicates ads from Mercado Libre, InfoCasas and other portals and shows the live median of asking rents without building fees; the figure moves daily (page saved 17 Nov 2026). The median 2-bed flat is about 60 m2. Cross-checks: InfoCasas sample of 160 two-bed flats, median UYU 36,000 (61 m2); Gallito/Inmuebles Data August 2026 median UYU 40,065 (via TheLatinvestor); INE's registered new apartment contracts averaged UYU 24,188 in September 2026 across all flat sizes (a trimmed mean, covering 55% of leases), so it reads lower.

UZ.note: Median of 5,908 listings from more than 200 Telegram channels, kvadro (kvadro.app), reported by Spot.uz on 9 Nov 2026. Cross-check: IMRI (Institute for Macroeconomic and Regional Research) reported a May 2026 median of USD 500 for 2-room flats and a citywide all-size median of USD 550; Central Bank of Uzbekistan: 1-room average USD 334 for 2025. Yakkasaray USD 800 is the dearest district, Bektemir USD 400 the cheapest.
